metadata.case_name: PHOON KA WAI v. WONG KA CHUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: chief cook in a Chinese restaurant
plaintiff.occupation_after: casual worker at Sunrise Kitchen (reduced duties, about two hours a day)

injuries.description: fracture of the right first rib
source: fracture of the right first rib

injuries.description: fracture of right distal radius and ulna
source: open reduction of fracture of radius and ulna with internal fixation
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of both ulna and radius

injuries.description: fracture of patella (right knee) with residual knee injury
source: C-sharp scar over patella 18 cm. Slightly swollen and increased in warmth of knee joint with tenderness around patella. Marked creptitation of patello-femoral joint on movement.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

source: Laceration scar at medial thigh 18 cm, with local tenderness at middle. Depressed scar, with adhesion to deep muscles of right thigh
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of hip or thigh
Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: postconcussional disorder and depression (acquired impairment in cognitive functioning and mood disorder)
source: He is suffering from postconcussional disorder.
He is depressed because of the physical and mental complaints.

manifestations.description: difficulty in attention, mildly to moderately impaired memory, mild intellectual impairment, difficulty expressing ideas, difficulty organising thought, slurred speech, slow response, becoming fatigued easily, headache, dizziness
depressed mood; moderately to severely depressed reaching a clinical level; low self-esteem, lack of interest in activities and sex, sleep problems
reduced ability to squat (can only squat to one-quarter)
walking in a slight limping gait; walks with a stick when on unfamiliar terrain; uses walking-stick for support
cannot stand for more than two hours at a time; needs rest every 15 to 20 minutes
muscle wasting on right arm and mild muscle wasting on right side of lower limbs
persistent right shoulder pain and stiffness with clicking sensation on movement
right wrist pain and tenderness at radial styloid; surgical scar 9 cm on volar site
depressed scar at medial thigh with adhesion to deep muscles of right thigh
reduced enjoyment of pre-accident hobbies (no longer able to mountain bike, play sports, motorcycle, pursue outdoor activities with his son)
difficulty concentrating; impaired concentration adversely affecting work and activities
difficulty using public transport, particularly getting on and off omnibuses
reduced job performance and inability to work as a full-time Chinese cook (cannot stand long periods or work heavy woks and ladles)

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of the patella (10 June 2001)
excisional debridement of wound, infection and burn (10 June 2001)
open reduction of wound and open reduction of fracture of radius and ulna with internal fixation (12 June 2001)
arthroscopy of right knee (9 November 2001 and 15 September 2003)
out-patient treatment at Orthopaedic Clinic of United Christian Hospital
treatment at Psychology Clinic at Kowloon Hospital (since 26 June 2001)
out-patient visits to Neurosurgical Department of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital (until around August 2002)
psychiatric and psychological treatment (clinical psychologist, psychotherapy)
treatments_future: further treatment for knee (removal of loose bone fragments) suggested
possible future operations on knee including total patellectomy or total knee replacement

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer enjoy the pre-accident hobby of mountain biking; no longer plays sports or pursues outdoor activities with his young son; no longer motorcycles.
Accident has left him depressed and irritable, and affected his relationship with his wife. Family life has become less harmonious.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Decrease in sexual activity and lack of interest in sex.
Restricted mobility requiring the use of a walking stick at times; limping gait; inability to squat fully; difficulty standing for prolonged periods.
Capacity to function as a full-time Chinese cook has been seriously compromised; cannot stand long periods or work heavy woks and ladles.
Deficits in several cognitive domains consistent with a mild decline in overall cognitive functioning, including impaired memory and concentration.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Difficulty using public transport, particularly getting on and off omnibuses.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Ting Lam v Leung Kam Ming
